comment: The Sample and Decay jacks carry no printing; the manual's opening section says every unlabelled jack is the CV input for the parameter beside it. Index order is not panel order: input 5, the Octave CV, is the left-hand jack of the pair below the Octave knob, and input 1, the 1V/Oct jack, is the right-hand one. The Decay knob is configured with a floor of 0.01 rather than 0 (OrchHits.cpp:73), so fully left gives a shade over the 100ms the mapping at line 148 starts from; 100ms and 5 seconds are the literals at lines 63 and 64. The decay coefficient is five time constants rather than one (line 149), so the knob reading is the time to near silence and not to a third of the level, which is what the one-shot modules use.
